sentences.en: Today, my colleagues Shane Goldmacher, Rob Zipko, and Carlos Prieto on what DeSantis' challenge has looked like on the ground in Iowa.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事肖恩·戈德马赫、罗伯·齐普科和卡洛斯·普列托将带我们了解德桑蒂斯在爱荷华州的竞选实况。

sentences.en: It's Friday, January 12th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月12日，星期五。

sentences.en: Shane, the question from the beginning of the Republican presidential race was, is there anyone who can beat Donald Trump?
sentences.zh: 肖恩，共和党总统竞选之初的问题是：有人能击败唐纳德·特朗普吗？

sentences.en: And as we sit here today, just a few days before the Iowa caucuses, the first Republican vote, Trump is more than 30 points ahead of his nearest rival,
sentences.zh: 而当我们今天坐在这里，距离爱荷华州党团会议——即共和党首场投票——仅剩几天时，特朗普领先他最接近的竞争对手超过30个百分点，

sentences.en: which is about as daunting an advantage as I've ever seen.
sentences.zh: 这大概是我见过最令人望而生畏的优势了。

sentences.en: And I think the question now is why exactly that has been the case,
sentences.zh: 我认为现在的问题是，为什么情况会变成这样，

sentences.en: and what have Trump's rivals been trying to do in these final weeks and days to try to defy the laws of political gravity and perhaps pull off some kind of a long shot upset in Iowa?
sentences.zh: 以及特朗普的竞争对手们在最后几周和几天里试图做些什么，来挑战政治重力法则，或许在爱荷华州上演一场爆冷逆袭？

sentences.en: Well, you're right.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你说得对。

sentences.en: It is daunting.
sentences.zh: 这确实令人望而生畏。

sentences.en: And it's so daunting that a number of his former rivals have quit, including Chris Christie, who left just this week.
sentences.zh: 而且它太令人望而生畏了，以至于他的一些前竞争对手已经退出了，包括本周刚退出的克里斯·克里斯蒂。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that's left really two people who are ostensibly still competing with Donald Trump, and that's Nikki Haley and it's Ron DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 这实际上只剩下两个人还在表面上与唐纳德·特朗普竞争，那就是妮基·黑利和罗恩·德桑蒂斯。

sentences.en: And in a lot of ways, the race has become a race for second place between the two of them.
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，这场竞选已经变成了他们两人争夺第二名的比赛。

sentences.en: And in that race, Nikki Haley's been gaining momentum and she's been raising money.
sentences.zh: 而在那场比赛中，妮基·黑利势头正劲，筹款也颇为顺利。

sentences.en: And while she's hoping to top DeSantis here, she's been more focused on the next states, on New Hampshire, where she polls more strongly, and then her home state of South Carolina.
sentences.zh: 虽然她希望在这里超越德桑蒂斯，但她更关注接下来的州，比如她在民调中表现更强的新罕布什尔州，以及她的家乡南卡罗来纳州。

sentences.en: But for Ron DeSantis, it's really Iowa.
sentences.zh: 但对罗恩·德桑蒂斯来说，关键就在爱荷华州。

sentences.en: He has set himself apart by saying this is a state he will win.
sentences.zh: 他通过宣称这是他必胜的州来让自己与众不同。

sentences.en: And he's in a tough spot.
sentences.zh: 但他现在的处境很艰难。

sentences.en: In a make-or-break state just days before the caucuses, he's found himself much closer to Nikki Haley than to Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 在党团会议前夕这个决定成败的州，他发现自己与妮基·黑利的差距比与唐纳德·特朗普的差距要小得多。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we've talked about DeSantis with you a lot.
sentences.zh: 我们和你讨论过很多次德桑蒂斯了。

sentences.en: And about the fact that his campaign has had a series of major missteps, miscalculations, and has had to really scale back its ambitions and focus them on Iowa.
sentences.zh: 也讨论过他的竞选团队犯下了一系列重大失误和误判，不得不缩减目标，将重心集中在爱荷华州的事实。

sentences.en: Not by choice, but a little bit by necessity.
sentences.zh: 不是出于选择，而是出于无奈。

sentences.en: Because his thinking is if we can do well in Iowa, maybe, just maybe, he can kind of resurrect this candidacy and make this a two-candidate race with Trump.
sentences.zh: 因为他的想法是，如果我们在爱荷华州表现出色，也许，仅仅是也许，他能重振竞选势头，让这场比赛变成他和特朗普之间的两人对决。

sentences.en: Yeah, he has gone all in on Iowa.
sentences.zh: 是的，他已经在爱荷华州孤注一掷了。

sentences.en: He's visited every single county in the state, the only one of the top candidates to do so.
sentences.zh: 他走访了该州每一个县，是主要候选人中唯一做到这一点的人。

sentences.en: He has got the backing of the state's popular Republican governor.
sentences.zh: 他获得了该州受欢迎的共和党州长的支持。

sentences.en: He's won the backing of one of the most important evangelical networks in the state.
sentences.zh: 他赢得了该州最重要的福音派网络之一的支持。

sentences.en: And his super PAC has just been knocking on door after door, more than 800,000 doors in the state so far.
sentences.zh: 他的超级政治行动委员会一直在挨家挨户敲门，到目前为止在该州已经敲了超过80万扇门。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: There's mailers, there's TV ads.
sentences.zh: 还有邮寄宣传单和电视广告。

sentences.en: It's hand-to-hand combat to find the very small number of people who are going to show up on a really cold night in Iowa.
sentences.zh: 这简直是肉搏战，只为找到那些在爱荷华州寒冷的夜晚愿意出来投票的少数人。

sentences.en: And the way the DeSantis team sees it is, look, they're campaigning the Iowa way.
sentences.zh: 德桑蒂斯团队的看法是，看，他们正在用爱荷华的方式竞选。

sentences.en: This is how some of those long shots surged at the last minute.
sentences.zh: 这就是一些黑马在最后一刻崛起的方式。

sentences.en: People like Rick Santorum, who were given little chance but, you know, had pounded the pavement in all 99 counties, he won.
sentences.zh: 像里克·桑托勒姆这样的人，起初几乎没人看好，但他跑遍了所有99个县，最后他赢了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Rick Santorum, of course, went on to lose the nomination and really didn't gain a ton of traction after Iowa.
sentences.zh: 当然，里克·桑托勒姆后来输掉了提名，在爱荷华州之后也没能获得太多支持。

sentences.en: But for the DeSantis campaign, this is the model.
sentences.zh: 但对德桑蒂斯团队来说，这就是模板。

sentences.en: Put in the maximum effort here.
sentences.zh: 在这里投入最大的努力。

sentences.en: And if it doesn't really work here, it's really hard to see how it's going to work for him anywhere else.
sentences.zh: 如果在这里都不奏效，很难想象他在其他地方还能怎么赢。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Long shots can and sometimes do win in Iowa.
sentences.zh: 黑马在爱荷华州确实有时能赢。

sentences.en: But given this daunting math of Trump's lead in the polls that we've just talked about, I'm curious, as you're describing this elaborate door-to-door,
sentences.zh: 但考虑到我们刚才谈到的特朗普在民调中那令人望而生畏的领先优势，我很好奇，在你描述德桑蒂斯团队这种详尽的挨家挨户、

sentences.en: hand-to-hand combat by the DeSantis campaign, what kind of voter he's trying to win over at this point?
sentences.zh: 肉搏式的竞选时，他现在试图争取的是什么样的选民？

sentences.en: Who exactly is the ideal target of this uphill DeSantis effort in Iowa?
sentences.zh: 德桑蒂斯在爱荷华州这场艰难战役的理想目标选民究竟是谁？

sentences.en: I think it's really important to answer that, to go back to the assumptions that the DeSantis campaign made at the very beginning of the race,
sentences.zh: 我认为回答这个问题非常重要，我们需要回到德桑蒂斯竞选团队在竞选之初所做的假设，

sentences.en: which is that voters in a Republican primary fall into three basic buckets.
sentences.zh: 即共和党初选中的选民可以分为三个基本群体。

sentences.en: The first bucket is the diehard Trump supporters, the people who are going to be with Trump from the beginning to the end,
sentences.zh: 第一个群体是特朗普的死忠粉，这些人从始至终都会支持特朗普，

sentences.en: and there's really nothing you can do to compete for them.
sentences.zh: 你真的没法去争取他们。

sentences.en: The second bucket is the sort of soft Trump supporters, people who like Donald Trump as president, people who are open to supporting him again, but also are open to an alternative,
sentences.zh: 第二个群体是所谓的“温和派”特朗普支持者，他们喜欢唐纳德·特朗普担任总统，愿意再次支持他，但也愿意考虑其他人选，

sentences.en: maybe somebody without as much baggage, maybe somebody who was younger.
sentences.zh: 也许是那些包袱没那么重的人，也许是更年轻的人。

sentences.en: And then the third bucket is the never-Trumpers, the people in the Republican Party who are absolutely ready to move on and we're not going to support Trump no matter what.
sentences.zh: 第三个群体是“反特朗普派”，即共和党内那些绝对准备好翻篇、无论如何都不会支持特朗普的人。

sentences.en: And so their theory of the case was basically that that second bucket, the soft Trump bucket, that that was the biggest of them all.
sentences.zh: 所以他们的竞选理论基本上是，第二个群体，即温和派特朗普支持者，是这三个群体中最大的一个。

sentences.en: And there were even more people there than folks were presuming.
sentences.zh: 而且那里的人数甚至比人们预想的还要多。

sentences.en: So at the heart of DeSantis' vision in a place like Iowa, you're saying, is the belief that perhaps there are actually a lot of people who are soft Trump supporters.
sentences.zh: 所以你是在说，德桑蒂斯在爱荷华州愿景的核心，是相信可能确实有很多人是温和派特朗普支持者。

sentences.en: And therefore, if you're campaigning and you meet somebody who says, I'm a Trump supporter, they actually might be available to DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你在竞选时遇到一个说“我是特朗普支持者”的人，他们实际上可能是德桑蒂斯可以争取的对象。

sentences.en: That is one of the essential questions of the entire Republican primary.
sentences.zh: 这是整个共和党初选最核心的问题之一。

sentences.en: Just how many of those Trump supporters are actually persuadable in 2024?
sentences.zh: 究竟有多少特朗普支持者在2024年是可以被说服的？

sentences.en: And for the DeSantis campaign, it's the existential question.
sentences.zh: 对于德桑蒂斯团队来说，这是一个生死攸关的问题。

sentences.en: And I think the best way to understand how the DeSantis campaign has approached this...
sentences.zh: 我认为理解德桑蒂斯团队如何处理这一问题的最好方法是……

sentences.en: That's Lance?
sentences.zh: 那是兰斯吗？

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That's Lance right there.
sentences.zh: 那就是兰斯。

sentences.en: ...is to meet a former Trump supporter who they actually won over.
sentences.zh: ……是去见一位他们确实争取过来的前特朗普支持者。

sentences.en: Are you the Lance?
sentences.zh: 你是兰斯吗？

sentences.en: How's it going?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: His name is Lance Lillbridge.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫兰斯·利尔布里奇。

sentences.en: It's good to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: Good to meet you too.
sentences.zh: 我也很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: And he's become an ardent DeSantis supporter out in eastern Iowa.
sentences.zh: 他已经成为了爱荷华州东部一位热情的德桑蒂斯支持者。

sentences.en: Do you mind giving us like a quick tour of the farm before we sit down and talk?
sentences.zh: 在我们坐下来谈话之前，介意带我们快速参观一下农场吗？

sentences.en: Where two of our producers for The Daily, Rob Zipko and Carlos Prieto, went to meet him last week.
sentences.zh: 我们《每日新闻》的两位制片人，罗伯·齐普科和卡洛斯·普列托，上周去见了见他。

sentences.en: Yeah, let's see.
sentences.zh: 好，来看看吧。

sentences.en: Let's go this way.
sentences.zh: 走这边。

sentences.en: Okay, so tell us about Lance.
sentences.zh: 好的，给我们介绍一下兰斯吧。

sentences.en: Well, he's a farmer who grows corn and he raises cattle.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他是一位种植玉米和饲养牛的农民。

sentences.en: I know you mentioned you're in the middle of calving season.
sentences.zh: 我知道你提到你正处于产犊季节。

sentences.en: I just had two this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上刚生了两头。

sentences.en: And he's been busy with all the new calves being born.
sentences.zh: 他一直忙于照顾刚出生的小牛。

sentences.en: You'll see him here in a second.
sentences.zh: 你马上就能见到他了。

sentences.en: Yeah, let me jump over the fence real quick.
sentences.zh: 好，我跳过栅栏过去。

sentences.en: Actually, Michael, the very first calf born in 2024 has a very special name.
sentences.zh: 其实，迈克尔，2024年出生的第一头小牛有一个非常特别的名字。

sentences.en: The first one born this morning, we named him DeSantis 24.
sentences.zh: 今天早上出生的第一头，我们给它取名叫“德桑蒂斯24”。

sentences.en: It's DeSantis 24.
sentences.zh: 就是“德桑蒂斯24”。

sentences.en: Like I said, this is a DeSantis success story.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，这是一个德桑蒂斯的成功案例。

sentences.en: And this cow is living on his farm of more than 1,500 acres.
sentences.zh: 这头牛生活在他超过1500英亩的农场里。

sentences.en: Does it ever get too cold for the cattle?
sentences.zh: 牛会觉得太冷吗？

sentences.en: I've never had a cow freeze to death.
sentences.zh: 我从来没遇到过牛冻死的情况。

sentences.en: I've come close to death.
sentences.zh: 我倒是差点冻死过。

sentences.en: And for many years, that's really just how he thought of himself as a farmer, not as somebody who was particularly politically engaged.
sentences.zh: 多年来，他一直认为自己只是个农民，而不是一个特别热衷政治的人。

sentences.en: I really haven't always been into politics.
sentences.zh: 我确实一直不太关心政治。

sentences.en: You know, in fact, I kind of despised him for most of my life.
sentences.zh: 你知道，事实上，我一生中大部分时间都有点鄙视政治。

sentences.en: But about a decade ago, that changed when he started working with what's really an important organization in Iowa, the Iowa Corn Growers Association.
sentences.zh: 但大约十年前，当他开始与爱荷华州一个非常重要的组织——爱荷华州玉米种植者协会——合作时，情况发生了变化。

sentences.en: And it's a group that lobbies politicians on behalf of corn farmers across the state.
sentences.zh: 这是一个代表全州玉米农民向政客游说的团体。

sentences.en: And I was asked to participate in a meeting there and was late to that meeting.
sentences.zh: 当时有人请我参加那里的会议，我迟到了。

sentences.en: And when I got there, I found out they voted me in as the county president.
sentences.zh: 当我赶到时，发现他们已经投票选我为县主席了。

sentences.en: So don't ever be late to a meeting, right?
sentences.zh: 所以，千万别开会迟到，对吧？

sentences.en: Lance says the politicians he was dealing with, they didn't actually understand farm policy.
sentences.zh: 兰斯说，他打交道的政客们其实并不了解农业政策。

sentences.en: And they didn't understand really what life was like for a farmer.
sentences.zh: 他们也不了解农民的生活究竟是什么样的。

sentences.en: And that whole experience, it was a big wake-up call.
sentences.zh: 整个经历让他大彻大悟。

sentences.en: And as Lance is experiencing this awakening, how does he describe his politics?
sentences.zh: 当兰斯经历这种觉醒时，他是如何描述自己的政治立场的？

sentences.en: Well, he describes himself as pretty conservative, as a Christian, pro-life.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他形容自己相当保守，是一名基督徒，反堕胎。

sentences.en: And then when 2016 rolled around...
sentences.zh: 然后到了2016年……

sentences.en: As you listen to Trump and as he confronted, the other party and the other GOP candidates, as far as that...
sentences.zh: 当你听特朗普讲话，看他对抗另一党和共和党其他候选人时，就这一点而言……

sentences.en: He was intrigued by Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 他被唐纳德·特朗普吸引了。

sentences.en: He wasn't afraid to come right out and say it.
sentences.zh: 他毫不避讳地直说了出来。

sentences.en: And that, I thought, was something that we needed.
sentences.zh: 我认为那是我们所需要的东西。

sentences.en: And he voted for him in 2016.
sentences.zh: 于是他在2016年投票给了他。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯嗯。

sentences.en: So I was kind of excited about...
sentences.zh: 所以我当时有点兴奋……

sentences.en: And then when Trump actually got into office, he liked a lot of what he had to say on certain issues,
sentences.zh: 后来特朗普真的上任了，他很喜欢他在某些问题上的言论，

sentences.en: especially on trade.
sentences.zh: 特别是在贸易方面。

sentences.en: We're going to make the best deal with China.
sentences.zh: 我们要和中国达成最好的协议。

sentences.en: China's going to buy our agricultural products.
sentences.zh: 中国会购买我们的农产品。

sentences.en: It's going to be great.
sentences.zh: 那会很棒。

sentences.en: Remember, Trump had promised he was going to renegotiate trade deals with China, that business was going to get better for American businesses.
sentences.zh: 记住，特朗普曾承诺他会重新谈判与中国的贸易协议，这样美国企业的生意会变得更好。

sentences.en: As a farmer, it made us think, we've got a future ahead of us.
sentences.zh: 作为一名农民，这让我们觉得，我们的未来是有希望的。

sentences.en: You know, I've got a daughter and a son that have an opportunity now to potentially come into this farming operation without having to sweat and lose sleep every night
sentences.zh: 你知道，我有一个女儿和一个儿子，他们现在有机会进入这个农场经营，而不必每天晚上都担惊受怕、彻夜难眠，

sentences.en: on whether they're going to be able to pay the next bill.
sentences.zh: 担心他们是否能付得起下一笔账单。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he, in fact, did start to rip up a lot of those trade agreements and understandings.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他确实开始撕毁了许多贸易协定和谅解备忘录。

sentences.en: And he imposed tariffs.
sentences.zh: 他还加征了关税。

sentences.en: And he made a whole number of changes to America's relationship with businesses abroad.
sentences.zh: 他对美国与海外企业的关系做了一系列调整。

sentences.en: But Lance says all those Trump policies that sounded good, they ended up backfiring for him.
sentences.zh: 但兰斯说，所有那些听起来不错的特朗普政策，最终对他来说都适得其反。

sentences.en: As Lance tells it, when these tariffs are imposed...
sentences.zh: 据兰斯讲述，当这些关税被征收时……

sentences.en: It was very difficult for equipment manufacturers to source what they needed to build equipment.
sentences.zh: 设备制造商很难采购到他们制造设备所需的原材料。

sentences.en: It raises the cost of the raw materials he needs to make his farm work.
sentences.zh: 这提高了维持他农场运作所需的原材料成本。

sentences.en: That made the price of equipment go up.
sentences.zh: 这导致设备价格上涨。

sentences.en: Things like farm equipment and fertilizer.
sentences.zh: 比如农用设备和化肥。

sentences.en: When those fertilizer tariffs got put into place, that becomes a higher cost to us.
sentences.zh: 当那些化肥关税实施时，我们的成本就更高了。

sentences.en: And those tariffs also set off a trade war with China.
sentences.zh: 而且这些关税还引发了与中国的贸易战。

sentences.en: And China stopped buying a lot of American agricultural goods.
sentences.zh: 中国停止购买大量美国农产品。

sentences.en: And Lance's businesses are getting squeezed.
sentences.zh: 兰斯的生意受到了挤压。

sentences.en: They're getting squeezed on both sides.
sentences.zh: 他两头受气。

sentences.en: His costs are going up.
sentences.zh: 他的成本在上升。

sentences.en: And he's not making as much money when he sells his products across America and across the world.
sentences.zh: 而当他在美国各地和世界各地销售产品时，赚的钱却变少了。

sentences.en: We were really standing on the edge of a cliff, ready to fall over.
sentences.zh: 我们当时真的站在悬崖边上，随时可能掉下去。

sentences.en: And luckily we didn't.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是我们没有。

sentences.en: But it was not an easy time.
sentences.zh: 但那段日子并不好过。

sentences.en: I don't ever want to go back to living like that.
sentences.zh: 我再也不想回到那种生活状态了。

sentences.en: In fact, he had to take part in a Trump administration program that amounted to a bailout
sentences.zh: 事实上，他不得不参加特朗普政府的一项计划，这相当于一种救助，

sentences.en: for farmers who all across the country were suffering from the trade war that had been started.
sentences.zh: 是为全国各地因贸易战而遭受损失的农民提供的。

sentences.en: And so, because of all of this, he starts to grow more and more disillusioned with Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 因此，由于这一切，他对唐纳德·特朗普越来越感到失望。

sentences.en: We've got this motivating speaker, Trump, out there talking about how this is going to get better.
sentences.zh: 我们有特朗普这位励志演说家，他在外面谈论着一切会好起来。

sentences.en: How it's going to be so much better, you know.
sentences.zh: 你知道，谈论着一切会变得多么好。

sentences.en: But in the background, we've got all these things that are falling apart.
sentences.zh: 但在幕后，我们看到所有这些事情都在分崩离析。

sentences.en: Come election day, though, did you vote for him?
sentences.zh: 不过，到了选举日，你投给他了吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 投了。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And yet, when we get to 2020, Lance stuck with Trump in that election.
sentences.zh: 然而，到了2020年，兰斯在选举中还是支持了特朗普。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: It's because he didn't like the alternative.
sentences.zh: 因为他不喜欢另一个选择。

sentences.en: I wasn't a Biden fan.
sentences.zh: 我不是拜登的粉丝。

sentences.en: I mean, I did not see anything good coming out of a Biden administration.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我没看出拜登政府能带来什么好结果。

sentences.en: So what was the worser of the two evils?
sentences.zh: 那么，两害相权取其轻，你是怎么看的？

sentences.en: You know, you kind of had to look at that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你得权衡一下。

sentences.en: Trump still had some good things going on for him.
sentences.zh: 特朗普身上还是有一些可取之处的。

sentences.en: So Lance feels like a kind of classic Trump voter.
sentences.zh: 所以兰斯感觉就像一个典型的特朗普选民。

sentences.en: Liked Trump's tough stance on trade, wanted a non-establishment, anti-establishment figure in the White House,
sentences.zh: 喜欢特朗普在贸易上的强硬立场，希望白宫里有一位非建制派、反建制派的人物，

sentences.en: also voted for him in 2016, stuck with him in 2020 despite some disappointments because there wasn't really a primary that year and he wasn't going to vote for a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 2016年投了他，2020年尽管有些失望也还是支持他，因为那年实际上没有初选，而且他不会投票给民主党人。

sentences.en: Obviously, now in 2024, there is a primary.
sentences.zh: 显然，现在到了2024年，有了初选。

sentences.en: There are alternatives to Trump.
sentences.zh: 特朗普有了竞争对手。

sentences.en: So how is Lance thinking about 2024?
sentences.zh: 那么兰斯是怎么看待2024年的呢？

sentences.en: So at the beginning of the 2024 cycle, Lance sort of fits into that soft Trump supporter category, maybe even borderline opposed to Trump.
sentences.zh: 在2024年竞选周期开始时，兰斯属于那种温和的特朗普支持者，甚至可能处于反对特朗普的边缘。

sentences.en: And he's determined to figure out, well, who will his Republican alternative be?
sentences.zh: 他决心弄清楚，谁会是他的共和党替代人选？

sentences.en: If I'm going to pick somebody, if I'm going to go out and pick that prize bull or that prize cow, and sorry, I don't mean to compare any of our candidates to cattle,
sentences.zh: 如果我要选一个人，如果我要去挑选那头优良的公牛或母牛——抱歉，我不是要把我们的候选人比作牲畜，

sentences.en: but if I'm going to go out and pick a winner, you know, I want to look at every attribute.
sentences.zh: 但如果我要去挑选一个赢家，你知道，我想看看每一个特质。

sentences.en: I want something that's got the whole package, you know.
sentences.zh: 我想要一个各方面都很出色的人，你知道。

sentences.en: And look, he's an influential figure in the farming community, and so some of these candidates are actually seeking him out for meetings.
sentences.zh: 看，他在农业社区是个有影响力的人物，所以其中一些候选人实际上是在主动找他会面。

sentences.en: Well, I had an opportunity to meet with almost all of them.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我有机会见到了他们中的几乎所有人。

sentences.en: I've met with Vivek, I've met with Doug, I've met with Nikki Haley.
sentences.zh: 我见过维韦克，见过道格，见过尼基·黑利。

sentences.en: And at some point, he eventually gets to meet Ron DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 后来，他终于见到了罗恩·德桑蒂斯。

sentences.en: So I was asked to meet with DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 有人邀请我与德桑蒂斯会面。

sentences.en: He got out of the car, we exchanged pleasantries, we sat down at a table, and I said, well, let's just not beat around the bush.
sentences.zh: 他下了车，我们寒暄了几句，坐到桌旁，我说，好吧，我们开门见山吧。

sentences.en: Where are you at on agriculture and where are you at on biofuels?
sentences.zh: 你在农业和生物燃料方面的立场是什么？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: That's how he answered it.
sentences.zh: 他就是这样回答的。

sentences.en: I need to learn more.
sentences.zh: 我需要多了解一些。

sentences.en: I don't understand the industry.
sentences.zh: 我不了解这个行业。

sentences.en: Tell me more.
sentences.zh: 多告诉我一些。

sentences.en: How can I learn more?
sentences.zh: 我该如何多了解一些？

sentences.en: And he was impressed with DeSantis and how he seemed open to hearing his concerns about his industry and his business.
sentences.zh: 他对德桑蒂斯印象深刻，觉得他似乎很乐意倾听自己对行业和生意的担忧。

sentences.en: After we had that conversation that day, one of his policymakers had called me and said, hey, if you've got time, let's talk about biofuels, let's talk about agriculture.
sentences.zh: 那天谈话后，他的一位政策制定者给我打电话说，嘿，如果你有时间，我们谈谈生物燃料，谈谈农业吧。

sentences.en: So I thought, wow, here's a candidate that had somebody call me and ask more specific questions.
sentences.zh: 所以我心想，哇，这位候选人竟然让人打电话给我，问更具体的问题。

sentences.en: And some weeks after that first meeting, Lance had another opportunity to meet with DeSantis with a bunch of farmers from all across the state.
sentences.zh: 在那次初次会面几周后，兰斯又有机会与德桑蒂斯以及全州的一群农民会面。

sentences.en: There must have been 30 or 40 farmers there.
sentences.zh: 当时大概有三四十个农民在那里。

sentences.en: And Governor DeSantis went around the room and introduced himself to every single person individually and had a conversation with every single person individually.
sentences.zh: 德桑蒂斯州长绕着房间，亲自向每个人做自我介绍，并与每个人单独交谈。

sentences.en: So it was probably all of 40 minutes or better before we actually sat down and then had more of a roundtable type meeting where guys could ask questions and talk about what's important to them as far as agriculture goes.
sentences.zh: 所以大概过了40多分钟，我们才真正坐下来，进行了一场圆桌会议，大家可以提问，谈论他们认为重要的农业问题。

sentences.en: How did you feel, though, at the end of that conversation or I guess the two conversations at those different facilities?
sentences.zh: 不过，在那次谈话结束时，或者说在那两个不同地点的两次谈话后，你感觉如何？

sentences.en: Well, I hadn't made up my mind yet, but I got to tell you that I've never seen a candidate engage people like that, whether it was a senator,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我还没拿定主意，但我得告诉你，我从未见过有候选人像那样与人互动，无论是参议员、

sentences.en: a representative or a presidential candidate.
sentences.zh: 众议员还是总统候选人。

sentences.en: And it wasn't long after that that Lance saw Ron DeSantis speaking on the campaign trail in the exact kind of way he wanted based on what he'd heard from Iowa farmers.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，兰斯就看到罗恩·德桑蒂斯在竞选活动中发表讲话，方式正是他所希望的那样，基于他从爱荷华州农民那里听到的反馈。

sentences.en: I think a lot of those things that were talked about that day, he's incorporated into some of his conversations and rallies.
sentences.zh: 我认为那天讨论的很多事情，他都融入到了他的一些谈话和集会中。

sentences.en: So Lance is really liking DeSantis, but what really clinches it is something that happens over the summer.
sentences.zh: 所以兰斯真的很喜欢德桑蒂斯，但真正让他下定决心的是夏天发生的一件事。

sentences.en: I was hit.
sentences.zh: 我被撞了。

sentences.en: He got into a pretty serious motorcycle accident.
sentences.zh: 他遭遇了一场相当严重的摩托车事故。

sentences.en: And it broke my leg and had some pretty severe damage.
sentences.zh: 我的腿断了，伤势相当严重。

sentences.en: It required some reconstructive surgery.
sentences.zh: 需要进行重建手术。

sentences.en: I got 36 staples, eight screws, a wire and a plate in my ankle and foot holding things together.
sentences.zh: 我的脚踝和脚里打了36个钉书钉、8颗螺丝、一根钢丝和一块钢板，把骨头固定在一起。

sentences.en: I was laid up and it's a Saturday morning and I get a phone call and that phone call was a no caller ID number.
sentences.zh: 我卧床不起，那是周六早上，我接到一个电话，是一个没有来电显示的号码。

sentences.en: And I thought it was the highway patrol calling me to, you know, ask questions about the accident.
sentences.zh: 我以为是公路巡警打来的，你知道，问关于事故的问题。

sentences.en: And it wasn't.
sentences.zh: 结果不是。

sentences.en: It was Governor DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 是德桑蒂斯州长。

sentences.en: And Ron DeSantis actually called him to check in.
sentences.zh: 罗恩·德桑蒂斯竟然亲自打电话来慰问。

sentences.en: He said, Lance, yeah.
sentences.zh: 他说，是兰斯吗？

sentences.en: Hey, this is Ron DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是罗恩·德桑蒂斯。

sentences.en: And I'm thinking, what?
sentences.zh: 我心想，什么？

sentences.en: He says, hey, he says, we heard you had an accident and we just, we wanted to call and see if you're doing okay.
sentences.zh: 他说，嘿，我们听说你出了事故，我们只是想打个电话看看你还好吗。

sentences.en: What's going on?
sentences.zh: 怎么样了？

sentences.en: You know, you all right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，你还好吗？

sentences.en: And so we had a really nice conversation and it really wasn't about the campaign.
sentences.zh: 所以我们进行了一次非常愉快的谈话，这真的与竞选无关。

sentences.en: And he cared.
sentences.zh: 他在关心我。

sentences.en: You know, that's how I felt.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我就是这种感觉。

sentences.en: That was very uplifting that day.
sentences.zh: 那天这让我感到非常振奋。

sentences.en: So it was really cool.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的很酷。

sentences.en: You know, I have to say, Shane, this is a bit surprising.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不得不说，肖恩，这有点令人惊讶。

sentences.en: This is not the version of DeSantis that we have come to understand.
sentences.zh: 这不是我们所了解的那个版本的德桑蒂斯。

sentences.en: He is pretty widely seen as a little bit cold, disconnected, not somebody who easily connects with voters.
sentences.zh: 他被普遍认为有点冷漠、疏离，不是那种容易与选民建立联系的人。

sentences.en: I mean, Michael, it's striking in that there's this conventional wisdom that's congealed about Ron DeSantis, is that he's weak on the stump and that he's awkward and wooden.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，迈克尔，这很引人注目，因为关于罗恩·德桑蒂斯有一种固有的成见，认为他在竞选中表现软弱，笨拙且木讷。

sentences.en: And for Lance, he thinks that portrayal of Ron DeSantis, it's the media's fault, which is, of course, what Ron DeSantis says, too, that they're not showing the real Ron DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 而兰斯认为，对罗恩·德桑蒂斯的这种刻画是媒体的错，当然，这也是罗恩·德桑蒂斯自己说的，说他们没有展示真实的罗恩·德桑蒂斯。

sentences.en: That is one thing that just absolutely frustrates me.
sentences.zh: 有一件事让我绝对感到沮丧。

sentences.en: When I turn on the TV and you get that from the media, he's not that way.
sentences.zh: 当我打开电视，从媒体那里听到这些时，他根本不是那样的人。

sentences.en: And so Lance feels like he knows the real Ron DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 所以兰斯觉得他了解真实的罗恩·德桑蒂斯。

sentences.en: And he decides he's going to support Ron DeSantis in the Iowa caucuses.
sentences.zh: 他决定在爱荷华州党团会议上支持罗恩·德桑蒂斯。

sentences.en: Which makes this, as you had hinted at earlier, a real success story for DeSantis' high-touch strategy in Iowa.
sentences.zh: 正如你之前暗示的那样，这使得德桑蒂斯在爱荷华州的高接触策略成为了一个真正的成功案例。

sentences.en: But it's the kind of success that would seem incredibly hard to replicate because you can't call every voter who gets into an accident.
sentences.zh: 但这似乎是一种极难复制的成功，因为你不可能给每一个出事故的选民打电话。

sentences.en: You can't call every voter in Iowa, period.
sentences.zh: 你不可能给爱荷华州的每一个选民打电话，根本不可能。

sentences.en: And if we're being honest, Lance is not just anybody.
sentences.zh: 而且说实话，兰斯并不是普通人。

sentences.en: He's somebody who is influential.
sentences.zh: 他是一个有影响力的人。

sentences.en: So he's not entirely representative of Republican voters.
sentences.zh: 所以他并不完全代表共和党选民。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This is a success, but it's a really hard one to repeat.
sentences.zh: 这是一个成功，但很难复制。

sentences.en: And so what Ron DeSantis needs is to convince Lance and then have Lance start to convince other people on his behalf.
sentences.zh: 所以罗恩·德桑蒂斯需要做的是说服兰斯，然后让兰斯开始代表他去说服其他人。

sentences.en: And actually, that's exactly what Lance decides to do.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这正是兰斯决定要做的。

sentences.en: He starts volunteering for the campaign to help get out the vote for Ron DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 他开始为竞选团队做志愿者，帮助罗恩·德桑蒂斯争取选票。

sentences.en: Basically, I feel like if I'm going to be all in on somebody, then I need to be all in on them.
sentences.zh: 基本上，我觉得如果我要全力支持某人，那我就得全心全意。

sentences.en: Okay?
sentences.zh: 好吗？

sentences.en: And I feel strongly that I've had a unique experience, and I need to be able to share that with others.
sentences.zh: 我强烈地感觉到我拥有独特的经历，我需要能够与他人分享。

sentences.en: And what has that looked like?
sentences.zh: 那看起来是什么样的？

sentences.en: Well, as he's recovering from his accident, he's sitting around his house and...
sentences.zh: 嗯，当他从事故中恢复时，他坐在家里……

sentences.en: I'm sitting around, and so I was calling and talking to people.
sentences.zh: 我坐在那儿，所以我就打电话和人们交谈。

sentences.en: I was trying to keep myself busy, and this was a good way to...
sentences.zh: 我试图让自己忙起来，这是一个很好的方式……

sentences.en: Hey, how you doing?
sentences.zh: 嘿，你好吗？

sentences.en: You got a couple minutes?
sentences.zh: 你有几分钟时间吗？

sentences.en: He says he's calling his friends and his family and other farmers.
sentences.zh: 他说他在给他的朋友、家人和其他农民打电话。

sentences.en: I'm just kind of curious.
sentences.zh: 我只是有点好奇。

sentences.en: Where are you at in this caucus?
sentences.zh: 在这个党团会议上你的立场是什么？

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 还有……

sentences.en: There's one person from the campaign that has sent me multiple texts.
sentences.zh: 竞选团队里有一个人给我发了多条短信。

sentences.en: Like, here's one.
sentences.zh: 比如，这一条。

sentences.en: Will you call Darla?
sentences.zh: 你能给达拉打电话吗？

sentences.en: Basically, anyone the campaign sends his way and says...

sentences.zh: 但如果，如果，如果他没对他们构成那么大的威胁，他们为什么不直接走开呢？

sentences.en: Lance, I saw you shrug your shoulder when he said he's that hated.
sentences.zh: 兰斯，我看到当他说他被如此憎恨时，你耸了耸肩。

sentences.en: Can you just give us your reaction to what Nate said about Trump?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我们说说你对内特关于特朗普的评价有什么反应吗？

sentences.en: Oh, I, I think Nathan's right.
sentences.zh: 哦，我，我觉得内森是对的。

sentences.en: I think he's extremely hated.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他确实非常招人恨。

sentences.en: Um, and, and by people in both parties, I mean, I don't, I, here's why I don't think that Trump will make it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且，而且是被两党的人（憎恨），我的意思是，我不，我，这就是为什么我觉得特朗普不会成功。

sentences.en: I could be wrong.
sentences.zh: 我也可能错了。

sentences.en: There's not a Democrat out there that vote for him.
sentences.zh: 没有民主党人会投票给他。

sentences.en: There's a very few independents that'll vote for him.
sentences.zh: 几乎没有独立选民会投票给他。

sentences.en: And there's a lot of Republicans that won't vote for him because they're never Trumpers.
sentences.zh: 而且有很多共和党人不会投票给他，因为他们是“反特朗普派”。

sentences.en: And so when you start doing the math, that's concerning to me.
sentences.zh: 所以当你开始算这笔账时，这让我很担心。

sentences.en: The math to me doesn't show him winning a general election.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这笔账显示他赢不了大选。

sentences.en: And so I've got to strategically think that through my mind, if he can't do that, who can?
sentences.zh: 所以我必须在脑子里战略性地思考，如果他做不到，谁能做到？

sentences.en: Who's the next person that can?
sentences.zh: 下一个能做到的人是谁？

sentences.en: And in my mind, that's DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，那是德桑蒂斯。

sentences.en: And it really captures actually a dynamic that's happening across the Republican Party, which is, and Lance is open about this, he's thinking strategically, who can we find who
sentences.zh: 这实际上捕捉到了共和党内正在发生的一种动态，那就是，兰斯对此很坦诚，他在进行战略性思考，我们能找到谁

sentences.en: can win?
sentences.zh: 能赢？

sentences.en: He's thinking, all these people, they hate Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 他在想，所有这些人，他们憎恨唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: He's polarizing.
sentences.zh: 他是个极具争议性的人物。

sentences.en: And that's the kind of candidate who might lose in November.
sentences.zh: 而那种候选人可能会在十一月落败。

sentences.en: He's being deeply pragmatic.
sentences.zh: 他表现得非常务实。

sentences.en: This is, this is the classic head versus heart argument.
sentences.zh: 这就是，这就是经典的理智与情感的争论。

sentences.en: And as you're sitting in the room, you're watching Nate sit there.
sentences.zh: 当你坐在房间里，看着内特坐在那儿。

sentences.en: And Nate, Nate is all heart in this debate.
sentences.zh: 而内特，内特在这场辩论中完全是凭感性行事。

sentences.en: You know, he may be hated.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他可能招人恨。

sentences.en: And I think that's also a good thing, though.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这其实也是件好事。

sentences.en: Because, you know, I'm sure there's a lot of people out there that hate me.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，我敢肯定外面有很多人恨我。

sentences.en: But there's a lot of people that respect me, though, also.
sentences.zh: 但也有很多人尊重我。

sentences.zh: 所以，他基本上是说，让人憎恨唐纳德·特朗普，那是一个卖点。

sentences.en: But Lance wasn't just making an electoral argument.
sentences.zh: 但兰斯不仅仅是在进行选举论证。

sentences.en: He was also saying, even if Trump wins, all these people that hate him, they're going to make him less effective.
sentences.zh: 他还在说，即使特朗普赢了，所有这些恨他的人，也会让他变得效率低下。

sentences.en: You look back at the history on things, and Trump lost a lot of seats in the House and the Senate and Republican side.
sentences.zh: 你回顾一下历史，特朗普在众议院和参议院以及共和党方面失去了很多席位。

sentences.en: And he's going to need all of that to get anything done.

sentences.zh: 他贬低我们的州长，仅仅因为她不支持他。

sentences.en: And another thing that I fear is retribution.
sentences.zh: 我担心的另一件事是报复。

sentences.en: How much of that's going to come into play with his first two years?
sentences.zh: 这在他执政的前两年里会占多大比重？

sentences.en: And not that I blame the guy.
sentences.zh: 并不是说我责怪他。

sentences.en: He's got a lot of people who have done him wrong.
sentences.zh: 他有很多被别人亏待过的人。

sentences.en: I'd want to get even with him as well.
sentences.zh: 我也想报复他们。

sentences.en: But if we take that out and really look at what we need in the country, we need leadership.
sentences.zh: 但如果我们抛开这些，真正看看这个国家需要什么，我们需要领导力。

sentences.en: We need somebody that's going to get something done.
sentences.zh: 我们需要一个能把事情办成的人。

sentences.en: We need somebody that's not a blowhard.
sentences.zh: 我们需要一个不是吹牛大王的人。

sentences.en: And I'm not saying that Donald Trump's a blowhard.
sentences.zh: 我不是说唐纳德·特朗普是吹牛大王。

sentences.en: I'm just saying we just need somebody that's going to do what they say they're going to do.
sentences.zh: 我只是说我们需要一个能言出必行的人。

sentences.en: And I fear that there's going to be so much resistance that it's going to play havoc on any kind of results.
sentences.zh: 我担心会有太多的阻力，这会给任何结果带来混乱。

sentences.en: So that's going to be one of the biggest reasons I'm all in on DeSantis.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我全力支持德桑蒂斯的最大原因之一。

sentences.en: And how does Nate respond to all of this?
sentences.zh: 内特对这一切有什么回应？

sentences.en: I mean, it's hard to quote a shrug, but he basically says, I'm still a Trump guy.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，很难引用一个耸肩的动作，但他基本上是说，我还是特朗普的支持者。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: Well, I totally agree.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我完全同意。

sentences.en: But we need somebody that the other countries are going to respect or fear.
sentences.zh: 但我们需要一个其他国家会尊重或畏惧的人。

sentences.en: And Trump has that.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普有这一点。

sentences.en: And it goes back to what I said before.
sentences.zh: 这又回到了我之前说的话。

sentences.en: We've got to start standing up for ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我们必须开始为自己挺身而出。

sentences.en: And I think he can do that better for us.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他能为我们做得更好。

sentences.en: I mean, what's your reaction when Lance says that strategically, you know, that DeSantis is a better pick?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当兰斯说从战略上讲，你知道，德桑蒂斯是更好的选择时，你有什么反应？

sentences.en: What do you think about it?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: There's a lot of good points.
sentences.zh: 有很多好的观点。

sentences.en: And it's hard for me to explain.
sentences.zh: 我很难解释。

sentences.en: So Nate, it seems, remains essentially immune to this pitch from Lance.
sentences.zh: 所以内特似乎基本上对兰斯的这套说辞免疫。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Lance, as he's going through this process, he even diagnoses at one point what he thinks is going on.
sentences.zh: 兰斯在经历这个过程时，甚至在某个时刻诊断出了他认为正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: Well, Nathan, if I can say that, I'm just going to say it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，内森，如果我能说的话，我就直说了。

sentences.en: I think that, and I respect this, I think that you feel like Trump is owed that second term because it was taken from him.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，而且我尊重这一点，我觉得你觉得特朗普理应获得第二个任期，因为他被剥夺了。

sentences.en: And we need to, he needs to get in there and be able to finish what he started.
sentences.zh: 我们需要，他需要进去并能够完成他开始的事情。

sentences.en: And, and I think that I'm thinking about this more strategically.
sentences.zh: 而且，而且我觉得我在更战略性地思考这个问题。

sentences.en: So I don't necessarily disagree with, with Nathan's thoughts.
sentences.zh: 所以我并不一定不同意内森的想法。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: But I'm thinking strategically more in a, in a business sense.
sentences.zh: 但我是在商业意义上更战略性地思考。

sentences.en: So I think maybe is that the dividing line?
sentences.zh: 所以我认为也许这就是分歧所在？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: What do you think?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I mean, we disagree on a lot of stuff.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们在很多事情上意见不合。

sentences.en: And at the end of the day, it's, we're still friends.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，我们还是朋友。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But even in this one conversation, there's a little bit of surprise.
sentences.zh: 但即使在这次谈话中，也有一点惊讶。

sentences.en: And I guess one of the questions is like, are you definitely showing up at a caucus for him next Monday?
sentences.zh: 我想其中一个问题是，你下周一真的会去党团会议支持他吗？

sentences.en: It might be negative five degrees.
sentences.zh: 气温可能会是零下五度。

sentences.en: If I wanted to go to a caucus, I would.
sentences.zh: 如果我想去党团会议，我会去的。

sentences.en: But will you?
sentences.zh: 但你会去吗？

sentences.en: I never have.
sentences.zh: 我从来没去过。

sentences.en: And that's that Nate is a decided Trump voter.
sentences.zh: 这就是内特是一个坚定的特朗普选民。

sentences.en: But even at the end of this long conversation, it wasn't clear for sure that he was going to show up on Monday and caucus for Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 但即使在这场漫长的谈话结束时，也不确定他是否真的会出现在周一的党团会议上为唐纳德·特朗普投票。

sentences.en: Fascinating.
sentences.zh: 太迷人了。

sentences.en: And that's really one of the questions that remains in this election is do people who like Trump, who haven't caucused before, do they show up?
sentences.zh: 这确实是这次选举中遗留的问题之一，那就是那些喜欢特朗普、以前没参加过党团会议的人，他们会出现吗？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And so if at this late date, there's any uncertainty about the results, it's because of that.
sentences.zh: 所以如果在这个晚些时候，结果还有任何不确定性，那是因为这个原因。

sentences.en: But let's presume that things do turn out the way that the polls anticipate that they will, which is that Trump will prevail in the Iowa caucuses.
sentences.zh: 但让我们假设事情确实如民调预期的那样发展，也就是特朗普将在爱荷华州党团会议上获胜。

sentences.en: How is Lance, no doubt a bit crestfallen by his inability to convert his friend Nate, how is Lance thinking about the prospect of Trump prevailing in Iowa?
sentences.zh: 兰斯，毫无疑问因为没能说服他的朋友内特而感到有点沮丧，他是怎么看待特朗普在爱荷华州获胜的前景的？

sentences.en: I asked him about that.
sentences.zh: 我问过他这个问题。

sentences.en: Let's say that Nate's right, and this is what polling shows too, which is that Trump is the likelier winner in Iowa.
sentences.zh: 假设内森是对的，民调也显示了这一点，即特朗普是爱荷华州更有可能的获胜者。

sentences.en: How are you going to feel if he ends up being your party's nominee?
sentences.zh: 如果他最终成为你们党的提名人，你会感觉如何？

sentences.en: Well, I'll have some disappointment for sure.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我肯定会感到有些失望。

sentences.en: I mean, who wouldn't, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，谁不会呢，对吧？

sentences.en: But I think that that disappointment needs to stop right there.
sentences.zh: 但我认为那种失望到此为止就够了。

sentences.en: He says if Trump wins the Iowa caucuses, he'd be not particularly happy about it.
sentences.zh: 他说如果特朗普赢了爱荷华州党团会议，他不会特别高兴。

sentences.en: But I would definitely support Trump rather than Biden.
sentences.zh: 但我肯定会支持特朗普而不是拜登。

sentences.en: When it comes to the general election, he'd vote for him again, even if a bit begrudgingly.
sentences.zh: 在大选时，他会再次投票给他，即使有点勉强。

sentences.en: And how would it feel to find yourself back in the voting booth voting for Trump one more time?
sentences.zh: 再次走进投票站为特朗普投票，感觉会如何？

sentences.en: It's kind of like rats.
sentences.zh: 就像老鼠一样。

sentences.en: There's some disappointment there.
sentences.zh: 会有一些失望。

sentences.en: It's like the cows got out.
sentences.zh: 就像牛跑出来了一样。

sentences.en: Dang it, now I got to go round them up again, you know?
sentences.zh: 该死，现在我又得去把它们赶回来，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I don't know if that's a great analogy or not, you know?
sentences.zh: 我不知道这算不算一个好的类比，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Another flat tire, we got to fix this.
sentences.zh: 又一个爆胎，我们得修好它。

sentences.en: It just seems like it's another maintenance item, I guess.
sentences.zh: 这看起来就像是另一个维护项目，我想。

sentences.en: All right, last question.
sentences.zh: 好了，最后一个问题。

sentences.en: What kind of effect is all this having on your friendship?
sentences.zh: 这一切对你们的友谊有什么影响？

sentences.en: None.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: None at all?
sentences.zh: 一点都没有？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Just another thing to argue about, right?
sentences.zh: 只是又多了一件可以争论的事情，对吧？

sentences.en: I'm going to get to go.
sentences.zh: 我得走了。

sentences.en: Told you so, Nathan, I told you so.
sentences.zh: 我告诉过你了，内森，我告诉过你了。

sentences.en: So, Shane, what Lance's experience with Nate, I think, demonstrates what your own reporting has also found is that in 2024, Republicans in general,
sentences.zh: 所以，肖恩，我认为兰斯与内特的经历证明了你自己的报道也发现的情况，那就是在2024年，共和党人总体上，

sentences.en: and really DeSantis in particular, they basically may just have gotten their math wrong, right?
sentences.zh: 尤其是德桑蒂斯，他们基本上可能只是算错了账，对吧？

sentences.en: They misunderstood how many Republican voters were ever really available to them.
sentences.zh: 他们误解了到底有多少共和党选民真正能为他们所用。

sentences.en: Yeah, Michael, if you look at polls, now, I'm in Iowa, but I can also look at national polling.
sentences.zh: 是的，迈克尔，如果你看民调，现在，我在爱荷华州，但我也可以看全国民调。

sentences.en: Donald Trump is at 60%, 70% in a lot of these surveys.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普在很多这些调查中支持率在60%到70%。

sentences.en: That means that those bucket presumptions, they weren't quite right.
sentences.zh: 这意味着那些关于选民群体的假设，并不完全正确。

sentences.en: That the number of people in that soft Trump category, either they all decided to go with Trump, or they were diehards all along.
sentences.zh: 那些处于“温和特朗普支持者”类别的人，要么他们都决定支持特朗普，要么他们一直都是铁杆支持者。

sentences.en: And so now, on the eve of the Iowa caucuses, the reality is that there seem to be a lot more Nates than Lances.
sentences.zh: 因此，在艾奥瓦州党团会议前夕，现实情况是，像内特这样的人似乎比兰斯多得多。

sentences.en: And that, more than anything, explains this lopsided state of the race as Iowans get ready to caucus.
sentences.zh: 而这，比任何其他因素都更能解释在艾奥瓦州选民准备参加党团会议之际，这场竞选为何会出现这种一边倒的局面。

sentences.en: Well, Shane, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢恩，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.zh: 顺便提一下，假期过后，我们下周将回来分析艾奥瓦州党团会议的结果。

sentences.en: You can look for the run-up and that special episode wherever you listen.
